item.title: Lumbar Fascial Manipulation — Focused Point Approach
clinicalUse: Selected myofascial lumbar movement restriction using the system's assessment logic
patientPosition: Prone or side-lying depending on selected point.
therapistPosition: Close to selected area with supported hand posture.
contact: Precise supported contact over selected fascial region, not broad random treatment.
forceDirection: Focused friction/pressure according to tissue orientation and system-specific hypothesis.
dosage: Short focused applications with reassessment; avoid unnecessary prolonged soreness.
safety: Avoid acute injury, open skin, infection, bleeding risk.
item.visualCue: Movement problem → selected fascial point → focused friction → same movement re-test.

subTechniques.name: Quadratus lumborum — Fascial Manipulation
subTechniques.clinicalGoal: Improve pain, movement tolerance or tissue-related function when this target is clinically relevant.
subTechniques.patientSetup: Prone, side-lying or supine with pelvis/trunk supported.
subTechniques.contact: Focused supported contact over the selected fascial area after movement-based assessment.
subTechniques.direction: Use focused friction/pressure according to the trained system and selected fascial point.
subTechniques.dosage: Brief focused applications with immediate movement reassessment.
subTechniques.reassess: Re-test the region's original pain, range or functional task.
